dashboard_calibration_empty_body: Predict a topic before studying it, then finish the session. The gap between the two is what this panel is for.
dashboard_calibration_figure_summary: {count} topics, each showing the confidence you committed to above the score you went on to get.
dashboard_calibration_legacy_excluded: {count} topics are left out: their score comes from the retired scorer and is not a measurement.
dashboard_calibration_unmeasured: {count} topics are predicted but not measured yet.
dashboard_due_empty_body: Nothing has fallen due. A session started now becomes a review later.
dashboard_next_action_quickstart: Nothing has been set up yet. Quickstart names your topics and takes your first predictions.
dashboard_next_action_resume: You left a session on {topic} unfinished. Its comparison needs the second half.
dashboard_next_action_review: {count} reviews are due. They are worth less every day they wait.
dashboard_next_action_study: Nothing is due. Start a session on whatever feels least settled.
dashboard_no_learning_path: This workspace has no numeric learning path selected, so nothing here can be scoped to it yet.
dashboard_panel_error: This part did not answer. The rest of the page is current.
dashboard_panel_unauthorized: This part is outside what your account may read.
dashboard_pressure_caption: Reviews falling due over the next week
dashboard_pressure_empty_body: No reviews fall due this week. The schedule fills up as you finish sessions.
dashboard_pressure_summary: {count} reviews fall due over the next seven days.
dashboard_sessions_empty_body: Sessions you start appear here, finished or not.
dashboard_summary: A compact operations view for review pressure, course context, and study readiness.
home_summary: A quiet shell for the authenticated Sophia application, ready for future API-backed routes.
login_error_invalid_credentials: The account or password did not match.
login_summary: Use your TU Wien credentials to open the Sophia workspace.
quickstart_done_body: Your topics are saved and your first predictions are on record. From here, studying is what turns them into a comparison.
quickstart_done_suggestion: Start with {topic} — it is the first thing you named.
quickstart_predict_body: Commit to how well you know each one before you study it. The prediction is half of what the dashboard later compares.
quickstart_predict_empty: There is nothing to rate yet.
quickstart_predict_legend: How well do you know {topic} right now?
quickstart_ratings_required: Rate at least one topic before continuing.
quickstart_save_failed: That could not be saved. Try again shortly.
quickstart_summary: Four steps to name what you are studying and take your first predictions. Nothing here is graded.
quickstart_topics_body: Name the topics you expect this course to cover. Rough guesses are worth more than none: the act of guessing is what pulls up what you already know.
quickstart_topics_empty: Nothing has been synced yet, so start from your own list.
quickstart_topics_required: Write at least one topic, or skip this step.
quickstart_welcome_act: Work: answer from memory before you look anything up.
quickstart_welcome_body: Sophia is built around one loop. It is worth knowing what it asks of you before you start.
quickstart_welcome_predict: Predict: say how well you know a topic, before studying it.
quickstart_welcome_reflect: Reflect: see the prediction against what happened.
review_empty_body: Nothing is due right now. Reviews appear here as the schedule brings topics back.
review_finished_body: {count} topics reviewed. The next dates are set.
review_grade_rejected: That review was not saved and the topic came back. Retry when you are ready.
review_prompt: Recall what you know about this topic, then check yourself.
review_recall_hint: Write it out before revealing. Retrieving it is what makes it stick.
review_summary: Topics the schedule has brought back. Scores and next dates come from the server; nothing here decides them.
settings_summary: Adjust display and language preferences for the current session.
study_act_summary: Write your answer, reveal, and rate how it went. Keyboard: space reveals, 1 to 4 grade.
study_band_overconfident: You knew this less well than you expected. That gap is the most useful thing on this page.
study_band_underconfident: You knew this better than you expected. Underrating yourself costs study time you did not need to spend.
study_band_unknown: Not enough answered yet to compare.
study_band_well_calibrated: Your prediction matched what happened. Trust that judgement next time.
study_dwell_blocked: Stay with the prompt a moment longer before revealing.
study_extend_failed: More cards could not be generated.
study_grade_rejected: That grade was not saved and the card came back. Retry when you are ready.
study_keyboard_note: Shortcuts are ignored while you are typing an answer. Every one has a button as well.
study_legacy_scored: This session carries a score from the old heuristic and is not comparable.
study_no_learning_path: This workspace has no numeric learning path selected, so study sessions cannot be scoped to it yet.
study_not_available: The study API did not answer. Try again shortly.
study_posttest_hint: Same question as before. Answer it again from memory.
study_predict_legend: How well do you know {topic} right now?
study_predict_required: Record a prediction and a pre-test answer before studying.
study_predict_summary: Commit to how well you think you know this topic, then answer one question before studying. Both are needed later to tell you what actually changed.
study_pretest_hint: Answer from memory. A wrong answer here is what makes the comparison at the end worth anything.
study_queue_empty: No cards left in this session.
study_reflect_summary: Answer the same question again, then take a moment before the numbers.
study_reflection_countdown: The results open in {seconds} seconds. Use them to write, not to wait.
study_reflection_prompt: Which part still feels unfinished, and why?
study_reflection_required: Write a reflection before opening the results.
study_reflection_too_soon: The reflection pause has not finished yet. Give it another moment.
study_reveal_blocked: {remaining} more characters of your own answer before you can reveal.
study_session_start_failed: The session could not be started.
study_sessions_empty: No sessions yet. Start one above.
study_summary: Predict, work, and reflect in one equilibration cycle. Scores come from the server; nothing here grades you on whether you typed something.
study_undo_already_committed: That grade is already saved, so it cannot be taken back.
